text:
rina: Quick sync — I'm assembling a 1-page field-friendly one-pager for enterprise prospects: wants = security, clear SLA bullets, a tiny deploy-mode decision flow, an SDR routing snippet, and two headline variants. Can we iterate here?

owen: Sounds good. Keep language outcome-focused. SLAs should be short and quantifiable.

kelly: Draft SLA bullets: 
- 99.95% platform availability (monthly)
- P95 generation latency targets by model class (e.g., <120ms small, <350ms large)
- Emergency response: 1hr for Sev1, 4hr for Sev2
Make them easy to scan.

marc: For deployment modes: suggest a tiny flow: Start Hosted -> scale to Dedicated for throughput -> move to Private if data residency or regulated. Use 3 mini blurbs not a table.

rina: For SDR routing, sales asked for something parseable. Proposal (pseudo-yaml snippet):
```
# SDR routing snippet (plain text)
lead.compliance: any of ["fedramp","hipaa","pci"] => team: enterprise-security
lead.expected_qps: >1000 => team: dedicated-sales
lead.budget: <50k => path: self-serve-nurture
else => path: discovery-call
```
Keep it single-line friendly for the one-pager.

owen: Webinar hook suggestion: "Practical SLOs and deployment choices that keep LLM features fast and compliant." Short CTA underneath.

kelly: Headline options: A) "LLM inference you can count on: secure, fast, SLA-backed" B) "From POC to production: predictable inference at enterprise scale" Which to use depends on the audience.

marc: Micro-case to include: "Payments fraud detection moved to Dedicated + KV cache -> reduced tail latency 60% and cut token cost 18%" Keep single sentence.

rina: Add one-line product note: "Private deployments supported via VPC or on-prem bundle; integrations with common KMS providers."

own: Visual guidance: three tiny tiles: speed (latency), efficiency (cost), compliance (controls) with one-line outcome each.

kelly: Field checklist (3 bullets): 
- Primary constraint? (Privacy / SLA / qps)
- Recommended mode & why
- Next step (security questionnaire / pilot / pricing)
Short, checkbox style.

ops-bot: FYI: Any security claims need Legal OK. Submit draft to /assets-review at least 24 hours before publish.

rina: I'll draft the layout and copy tonight. Owen can validate SLA numbers and Marc will verify the micro-case. Kelly will produce the two headline variations in slightly different tones.

own: I'll check the latency numbers vs our benchmarks and confirm wording.

marc: I'll confirm the micro-case metrics and link the anonymized benchmark spreadsheet.

kelly: I'll mock two micro-headlines for A/B and a 30s webinar intro: "Most teams trade off compliance or latency. We'll show a path that minimizes both using tiered routing, caching, and fallbacks."

rina: Great. Action list: rina compile + submit to /assets-review, owen SLA validation, marc micro-case validation, kelly headlines + webinar 30s, all by EOD tomorrow. Ping here if blocked. :white_check_mark:
